scripts.translation: - 這個棺材看起來很可疑。 -
- 你雖然離開了，但心中仍存疑慮。 -

scripts.text: This is not a big deal!
Your head is pumping out strawberry jam!
scripts.translation: 你的頭都快流出草莓醬了！

scripts.text: I was happy with you.....though it was short time...
scripts.translation: 雖然和你相處的時間很短...但我很開心...

scripts.text: I forget everytime as I died for a long time ago.
scripts.translation: 我早就死了很久，每次都會忘記。

scripts.text: We are not supposed to waste time like this!
scripts.translation: 我們不能這樣浪費時間！

scripts.text: We will die if we dont get back to master with ^ff9000'that'^000000...
scripts.translation: 如果不把^ff9000“那個”^000000帶回去交給主人，我們會死的...

scripts.text: We will be bothered by him until we lose his temper at the most.
scripts.translation: 他會一直煩我們，直到最後徹底發火。

scripts.text: We gonna die with sun burn if we leave now.
scripts.translation: 現在出去的話，我們會被太陽曬死的。

scripts.text: You MUST say that much important thing in advance!!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation: 這麼重要的事你必須提前說啊！！！！！！！！！

scripts.text: This world was good only we were alive.
scripts.translation: 只有活著的時候，這個世界才美好。

scripts.text: You are the first man made my head pump out strawberry jam.
scripts.translation: 你是第一個把我的腦袋打得流出草莓醬的人。

scripts.text: - There is more jam coming out under the coffin. -
scripts.translation: - 棺材下面流出了更多草莓醬。 -

scripts.text: He is little bit strange as for the jam he bleeded.
scripts.translation: 他流出的醬是草莓味的，有點奇怪。

scripts.text: Now I feel very refreshed, would you put down that club??
scripts.translation: 我現在感覺好多了，可以把棍子放下了嗎？？

scripts.text: I don't blame you for making my head like this but would you help us?
scripts.translation: 我不怪你把我的頭打成這樣，不過你能幫幫我們嗎？

scripts.text: The strawberry thing will be recovered after few days of illness.
scripts.translation: 草莓醬的事，病幾天就會恢復了。

scripts.text: I will explain properly, just put that down.
scripts.translation: 我會好好解釋的，先把那個放下。

scripts.text: Well, then we have to go out Treat!
We just will be sent back to Niflheim in the worst case.
scripts.translation: 最壞也不過是被送回尼夫海姆。

scripts.text: ^ff9000Pumpkins are any of field. Please collect organic or non-organic pumpkins for 30 people and bring them to Chef Candycon at Niflheim.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff9000田裡的南瓜都可以。請收集足夠30人份的有機或普通南瓜，帶給尼夫海姆的糖果糖主廚。^000000

scripts.text: It is three times as useful!
scripts.translation: 效果是普通南瓜的三倍！

scripts.text: Thanks! We won't die from sun burn!
scripts.translation: 謝謝！我們不會被太陽曬死了！

scripts.text: And if you don't mind, would you please help more?
scripts.translation: 如果你不介意，可以再幫我們一點忙嗎？

scripts.text: Last time when I visited there, I saw piled up pumpkin cake which was taller than castle... how much should we make more?
scripts.translation: 上次我去的時候，看到堆起來的南瓜蛋糕比城堡還高...到底還要做多少？

scripts.text: ^ff9000Pumpkins are any of field. Please collect organic or non-organic pumpkins for 30 people and bring them to Chef Candycon at Niflheim.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff9000田裡的南瓜都可以。請收集足夠30人份的有機或普通南瓜，帶給尼夫海姆的糖果糖主廚。^000000

scripts.text: It is three times as useful!
scripts.translation: 效果是普通南瓜的三倍！

scripts.text: Well, then we have to go out Treat!
We just will be sent back to Niflheim in the worst case.
scripts.translation: 最壞也不過是被送回尼夫海姆。

scripts.text: We are from ^ff9000'town of the dead' Niflheim^000000.
scripts.translation: 我們來自^ff9000“死者之城”尼夫海姆^000000。

scripts.text: ^ff9000The pumpkins for Halloween event on Niflheim^000000 were all disappeared.
scripts.translation: ^ff9000尼夫海姆萬聖節活動用的南瓜^000000全都不見了。

scripts.text: First we are preparing another cake but Sir, Hell loves pumpkin cake....... Halloween without pumpkin cake is like vampire without fang...
scripts.translation: 我們先準備再做一批蛋糕。不過，地獄先生最愛南瓜蛋糕...沒有南瓜蛋糕的萬聖節，就像沒有獠牙的吸血鬼...

scripts.text: We came to search pumpkin as our chef is too busy to do with other things,
scripts.translation: 主廚忙著處理別的事情，所以我們來找南瓜，

scripts.text: Far from searching them, we are at risk for leaving this coffin...
scripts.translation: 不過別說找南瓜了，我們連離開棺材都很危險...

scripts.text: ^ff9000Pumpkins are any of field. Please collect organic or non-organic pumpkins for 30 people and bring them to Chef Candycon at Niflheim.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff9000田裡的南瓜都可以。請收集足夠30人份的有機或普通南瓜，帶給尼夫海姆的糖果糖主廚。^000000

scripts.text: It is three times as useful!
scripts.translation: 效果是普通南瓜的三倍！

scripts.text: Phew... when is the end of making this cake? ...feel like eternal...
scripts.translation: 呼...這蛋糕什麼時候才能做完？...感覺沒完沒了...

scripts.text: Holy mother! I will hang anyone who suggest to make pumpkin cake on tree from next time.
scripts.translation: 我的天！下次誰再提議做南瓜蛋糕，我就把他吊到樹上。

scripts.text: Though Sir, Hell like this but he doesn't care what pumpkin used. He said he is good with normal but...
scripts.translation: 雖然地獄先生喜歡南瓜蛋糕，但他不在乎用什麼南瓜。他說普通南瓜也行，可是...

scripts.text: ALWAYS saying this pumpkin is not good....only the organic is good...what the heck, are you a cook!? If you know cooking that much why don't you do it by yourself!!
scripts.translation: 他總是說這種南瓜不行...只有有機南瓜才好...搞什麼啊，你是廚師嗎！？你這麼會做，怎麼不自己來！！

scripts.text: And never helped me for escaping pumpkins and pretend busy? UGH! tut~
scripts.translation: 南瓜逃跑時你從不幫忙，還裝作很忙？真是的！嘖~

scripts.text: Ah... I'm not supposed to speak like this... we also have image making issue....
scripts.translation: 啊...我本來不該這樣說話...我們也得顧及形象...

scripts.text: Speaking like this is way better to scare people...heww..however, I can't bare it as it is too stuffy.
scripts.translation: 這樣說話確實更能嚇人...呼...不過實在太難受了，太憋悶。

scripts.text: Anyway! It won't be delayed if those pumpkins didn't escape to Midgard.
scripts.translation: 總之！要不是那些南瓜逃到米德加爾特，事情也不會拖到現在。

scripts.text: Obviously, we are dead so we are pretty weak to the sun. We would be a pile of ash if we searched during daytime.
scripts.translation: 顯然，我們已經死了，所以很怕太陽。要是白天出去找南瓜，我們就會變成一堆灰。

scripts.text: Did you know?! How could you send us to search for pumpkins?!
scripts.translation: 你知道嗎？！怎麼能叫我們去找南瓜？！

scripts.text: What? You can walk around after sunset. And you got wings and night vision... and what? Ultra sonic...?!!!!
scripts.translation: 什麼？你們日落後就能到處走，還有翅膀和夜視能力...還有什麼？超音波...?!!!!

scripts.text: So I didn't leave the coffin.
Gosh. How fortune we are for your effort, considering the process after bringing pumpkins.
scripts.translation: 天哪，多虧你幫忙，不然把南瓜帶回來之後還有一堆麻煩事。

scripts.text: Let me see! Correct? Yeah that's it! Hold on a sec.
scripts.translation: 讓我看看！對嗎？沒錯，就是這個！等一下。

scripts.text: Heck... seriously... How many more left?
If we don't work fast, we will late for the festival.
scripts.translation: 我們不快點的話，就趕不上節日了。

scripts.text: Yo! Thanks to your delivery, baking cake day and night.
scripts.translation: 喲！多虧你送來南瓜，我們可以日夜不停地烤蛋糕了。

scripts.text: Laying on the tomb will not guarantee eternal sleeping. T.T
scripts.translation: 躺在墳墓裡也不一定能永遠安眠。T.T

scripts.text: If we don't work fast, we will be late for the festival.
scripts.translation: 我們不快點的話，就趕不上節日了。

scripts.text: Okay! Dig out the inside of pumpkin and like this~ and that~!
scripts.translation: 好！把南瓜裡面掏空，然後這樣~再那樣~！

scripts.text: Cool! Pumpkin has been carved just in shape? This is it for Halloween! Halloween without Jack'o lantern can't be real Halloween!
scripts.translation: 酷！南瓜雕得真有型！這才是萬聖節！沒有南瓜燈就不算真正的萬聖節！

scripts.text: Take this, it's a reward for bringing pumpkins! Open it, there might be some fun stuff...
scripts.translation: 拿著，這是送南瓜的獎勵！開啟看看，說不定有有趣的東西...

scripts.text: Ooops where is pumpkin? Escaped again?
scripts.translation: 哎呀，南瓜去哪兒了？又逃跑了？

scripts.text: Oh, boy...no... you should go to get them again...
scripts.translation: 天哪...不...你得再去把它們找回來...

scripts.text: eeh~~ You have no use of those pumpkins~~
It's really fresh, outside of coffin?
scripts.translation: 棺材外面真是空氣清新啊？

scripts.text: If you brought them all, deliver them to the chef there.
scripts.translation: 如果都拿齊了，就把它們交給那邊的主廚。

scripts.text: What would happen without your help?~
scripts.translation: 沒有你的幫助可怎麼辦呀？~

scripts.text: Maybe, Sir, Hell would have grilled bat, instead of pumpkin cake.
scripts.translation: 說不定地獄先生就只能吃烤蝙蝠，而不是南瓜蛋糕了。

scripts.text: As I will just mess up everything! Wahahahaa!
scripts.translation: 反正我只會把事情搞砸！哇哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Ho.. these seeds have really deep taste.
scripts.translation: 哦..這些種子的味道真濃郁。

scripts.text: I will be able to have this kind of seeds no matter how much.
scripts.translation: 這種種子來多少我都吃得下。

scripts.text: You are eating alone too much!
The festival is about to begin...
Living creatures can't participate in the festival of Niflheim. -giggle-
scripts.translation: 活人不能參加尼夫海姆的慶典。-咯咯笑-

scripts.text: The festival brought vitality to 'city of the dead'....
scripts.translation: 慶典讓“死者之城”也充滿了活力...

scripts.text: Doesn't it seem like something is wrong??
scripts.translation: 你不覺得好像哪裡不對勁嗎？？

scripts.text: Soon, the festival of souls will be here!
scripts.translation: 靈魂慶典馬上就要開始了！
